squareCube.title: The square-cube law
squareCube.hint: Double an animal's length and its mass goes up eightfold, but the bone cross-section that carries it goes up only fourfold. The stress on every bone therefore doubles. That is why a body cannot simply be scaled up - its shape is forced to change.

froudeDial.title: Froude gait dial
froudeDial.hint: At the same leg length, Pandora's lower gravity pulls every gait transition down to a lower speed. The pa'li breaks into its efficient spring-loaded gaits sooner - and each footfall lands softer for it.

flightCeiling.title: The wall every flyer hits
flightCeiling.hint: The demand curve climbs steeper than the supply curve, so they always cross. The crossing is the heaviest a flyer can still flap. Pandora's lower gravity and denser air pull the demand curve down - sliding the crossing rightward, to a mass Earth would pin to the ground.

superconductor.title: Superconductor cool-down
superconductor.hint: Drop the temperature below Tc: resistance falls straight to zero and the magnet locks, hanging in mid-air.
